title: Share of developers using AI tools
description: Percentage of respondents to three recurring developer surveys who say they use AI tools in their work.
notes: Each survey asks its own question of its own sample, so compare the lines' direction more than their heights. Stack Overflow asked whether people use AI tools in their development process the same way from 2023 to 2025; it recruits through its own site, whose users are falling away, and its respondents fell from 89,000 in 2023 to 31,000 in 2026. JetBrains reweights its sample to correct for its own users. DORA, run by Google Cloud, surveys a few thousand professionals. A hollow circle is a figure asked differently from the rest of its line: Stack Overflow's 2026 question covers AI tools or agents at work, JetBrains' 2026 figure counts professional developers using coding agents at least weekly, and DORA's 2024 figure counts reliance on AI for any of a list of daily tasks. Points sit at the middle of each survey's fieldwork, and every figure's citation is in manual/developer-ai-use.csv.
